## 🎯 Feature Description
**What feature would you like to see implemented?**

A clear and concise description of what the feature should do.

Describe the current limitation or pain point this feature would address.

**How should this feature work?**

Describe your proposed solution or approach.

## 🎨 User Experience
**How would users interact with this feature?**

Describe the user journey and interface considerations.

## 📊 Impact Assessment
**What is the business/technical impact?**

- [ ] High Impact - Critical for platform success

**Any technical details or constraints?**

- Architecture implications
